subject: Atlas Health pilot — approval path, econ sponsor intro, and procurement onramp
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Tom Richey <tom.richey@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas demo recap + next steps (pilot scope + security)

Tom — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our 30-min demo and three suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) What we saw: low-latency inference for your triage workflows, embeddings-based similarity for historical case retrieval, and an initial cost/latency estimate for a 3-week pilot.

2) Action items I/O: I attached a short pilot scope (pilot-scope-and-pricing.xlsx) and our security questionnaire (Atlas-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf). If you could share the name of the economic sponsor who would sign off on a pilot + the procurement contact we can spin up a mutual action plan.

3) Proposed timeline: intro to econ sponsor + procurement this week, 30-min alignment call next week, pilot kick within 2–3 weeks pending security review.

Questions for you now: who owns the budget approval (title/name) and is there an internal procurement deadline we should be aware of? Also, are there any required SLAs or data residency constraints?

I’ll follow up with a one-pager for Finance and a short checklist for Security.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot-scope-and-pricing.xlsx (spreadsheet), Atlas-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Tom Richey <tom.richey@atlashealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas demo recap + next steps (pilot scope + security)

Aditya — thanks for the recap and the materials. Quick answers: 

• Economic sponsor: Priya Ghosh, CFO (priya.ghosh@atlashealth.com). She owns pilot approvals under our innovation budget.
• Procurement: procurement@atlashealth.com (I’ll loop them in as well).
• SLAs/data residency: we need SOC2 evidence and a data retention policy; US-only hosting is preferred but not mandatory for the pilot.

I’ll introduce Priya formally after you send the one-pager for Finance. We’re aiming to get pilots started before the end of the quarter (end of Oct).

Tom
Director of Clinical Ops
Atlas Health
tom.richey@atlashealth.com
